cases.name: define-and-call
cases.template: {% macro m() %}X{% endmacro %}{{ m() }}

cases.name: keyword-args
cases.template: {% macro m(a, b) %}{{ a }}-{{ b }}{% endmacro %}{{ m(b=2, a=1) }}

cases.name: varargs
cases.template: {% macro m() %}{{ varargs|join(',') }}{% endmacro %}{{ m(1,2,3) }}

cases.name: kwargs
cases.template: {% macro m() %}{{ kwargs['a'] }}{% endmacro %}{{ m(a=1) }}

cases.name: escaping-inside
cases.template: {% macro m(v) %}{{ v }}{% endmacro %}{{ m('<b>') }}

cases.name: macro-output-is-safe
cases.template: {% macro m() %}<b>{% endmacro %}{{ m() }}

cases.name: cannot-see-caller-locals
cases.template: {% macro m() %}[{{ local }}]{% endmacro %}{% set local = 'x' %}{{ m() }}

cases.name: sees-template-globals
cases.template: {% set g = 'G' %}{% macro m() %}{{ g }}{% endmacro %}{{ m() }}

cases.name: loop-inside-macro
cases.template: {% macro m(l) %}{% for x in l %}{{ x }}{% endfor %}{% endmacro %}{{ m([1,2]) }}

cases.name: macro-calls-macro
cases.template: {% macro a() %}A{% endmacro %}{% macro b() %}{{ a() }}B{% endmacro %}{{ b() }}

cases.name: call-block
cases.template: {% macro m() %}[{{ caller() }}]{% endmacro %}{% call m() %}inner{% endcall %}

cases.name: call-block-with-args
cases.template: {% macro m() %}{{ caller('x') }}{% endmacro %}{% call(v) m() %}<{{ v }}>{% endcall %}

cases.name: call-block-nested
cases.template: {% macro m() %}[{{ caller() }}]{% endmacro %}{% call m() %}{% call m() %}deep{% endcall %}{% endcall %}
